fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact JSON of this object with fingerprint_sha256 and fingerprint_definition omitted
hypothesis: A 72-hour price breakout that occurs immediately after a causally observed low-volatility compression has positive 24-hour continuation expectancy after conservative costs on both BTC and ETH, because clustered stops/liquidations and trend-following flows around recent extremes can create short-lived continuation.
economic_mechanism: Compression reduces two-sided realized movement while liquidity and stop orders accumulate around recent extremes; a subsequent close beyond the prior 72-hour range may trigger directional stop/liquidation and momentum flows that persist into the next 24 hours.

history_request.coverage_policy: use the complete normalized history actually returned up to the frozen 50000-bar bound and report exact first/last timestamps; never synthesize missing older history

source.reason: Fixed ex-ante BTC/ETH asset set avoids historical survivor-membership selection.

decision_schedule.entry: first eligible completed-bar open strictly after the decision timestamp
decision_schedule.exit: first eligible completed-bar close at or after entry + 24h

features.breakout_reference: prior completed bars only; exclude decision bar
features.compression_measure: rolling 24h realized volatility = population standard deviation of hourly log returns over the 24 completed hours immediately preceding the decision bar
features.percentile_causality: compute threshold from trailing completed observations only; no current/future outcome data

signal_rule.BUY: compression is true AND decision close > maximum high of prior 72 completed hourly bars
signal_rule.SELL: compression is true AND decision close < minimum low of prior 72 completed hourly bars

baseline.rule: same BUY/SELL breakout rule and decision schedule but without compression filter

costs.funding_carry_note: No promotion claim is permitted unless any required funding/carry for the intended executable instrument is separately modeled or conservatively bounded.

chronology.split: chronological 60% train / 40% validation by eligible decision timestamps

required_for_each_asset: train mean after-cost signed return > 0 at 3x cost
validation mean after-cost signed return > 0 at 3x cost
required_aggregate: BTC+ETH aggregate train mean after-cost signed return > 0 at 3x cost
BTC+ETH aggregate validation mean after-cost signed return > 0 at 3x cost
pre_oos_pass_rule.incremental_baseline_requirement: candidate validation mean after-cost signed return at 3x cost must exceed the frozen no-compression baseline on the same eligible decision timestamps
pre_oos_pass_rule.validation_stability: both chronological halves of validation must have non-negative mean after-cost signed return at 1x cost when each half has at least 5 actionable signals; otherwise mark stability INSUFFICIENT rather than pass

sensitivity_policy: Sensitivity checks are falsifiers only. They cannot replace the frozen primary parameters or be cherry-picked to create a passing candidate.

selection_result_policy.on_fail: REJECT_PRIMARY_FINGERPRINT; keep OOS locked; do not tune/rescue using validation outcomes
selection_result_policy.on_pass: freeze exact candidate fingerprint and exact dataset identity before requesting untouched OOS
